blocks.text: Entropy ka tasawwur thermodynamics ke mutaale mein Rudolph Clausius ne 1856 mein doosre qanoon ko miqdari bunyad dene ko shamil kiya. Yeh dabao, volume, temperature aur internal energy ke saath system ki halat bayan karne ko ek aur variable deta hai.

blocks.title: Entropy
blocks.text: Agar system reversible amal se guzre jis ke doran woh mutlaq temperature T par heat ki miqdar delta Q jazb kare, to system ke entropy S naami state variable mein izafa delta S = delta Q / T ... (6.8). Potential energy ya internal energy ki tarah system ki entropy ki tabdeeli aham hai. Entropy ki tabdeeli heat dene par musbat aur system se heat hatane par manfi hai.

Farz karein heat ki miqdar Q temperature T1 ke reservoir se conducting rod ke zariye temperature T2 ke reservoir tak bahti hai, jahan T1, T2 se bara hai. T1 par reservoir ki entropy, jo heat khota hai, Q/T1 se ghatti hai, aur T2 par reservoir ki, jo heat pata hai, Q/T2 se barhti hai. Chunke T1, T2 se bara hai, Q/T2, Q/T1 se bara hai; is liye entropy ki khalis tabdeeli (Q/T2 - Q/T1) musbat hai. Is se nikalta hai ke un sab qudrati amal mein jahan heat ek system se doosre ko bahe, entropy mein hamesha khalis izafa hota hai. Yeh thermodynamics ke doosre qanoon ka ek aur bayan hai:

blocks.title: Entropy ke zariye doosra qanoon
blocks.text: Agar system qudrati amal se guzre to woh us simt mein jayega jo system jama mahol ki entropy barhaye.

Qudrati amal zyada be-tarteebi ki halat ki taraf jata hai, to entropy aur molecular be-tarteebi mein taalluq hai. Maslan kisi system ke garam se thande madde tak irreversible heat flow be-tarteebi barhata hai, kyunke molecules shuru mein garam aur thande hisson mein alag hote hain; system ke thermal equilibrium par aane par yeh tarteeb kho jati hai. System ko heat dena us ki be-tarteebi barhata hai kyunke ausat molecular speeds aur is liye molecular harkat ki be-tarteebi barhti hai. Isi tarah gas ka azaad phailao us ki be-tarteebi barhata hai kyunke phailne ke baad molecules ki jagah pehle se zyada be-tarteeb hoti hai. Dono misalon mein entropy barhi kahi jati hai. Hum nateeja nikal sakte hain ke sirf woh amal mumkin hain jin ke liye system ki entropy barhe ya mustaqil rahe: jis amal mein entropy mustaqil rahe woh reversible hai, jabke sab irreversible amal mein system ki entropy barhti hai.

Har bar entropy barhne par kuch heat ko kaam mein badalne ka mauqa kho jata hai. Maslan garam aur thanda pani milane par entropy barhti hai; aakhir neem garam pani garam aur thandi tah mein alag nahi ho sakta. Energy ka koi nuqsan nahi hua, magar kuch energy ab kaam mein badalne ko dastiyab nahi. Is liye entropy ka izafa energy ke zyada oonche darje se, jahan zyada kaam nikala ja sakta hai, kam darje tak girne (degradation) ka matlab hai jahan kam ya koi mufeed kaam nahi ho sakta: energy ek lihaz se girti hai, zyada munazzam shakal se kam munazzam shakal ki taraf, aakhir thermal energy ban kar. Un sab real amal mein jahan heat ki muntaqili ho, mufeed kaam ke liye dastiyab energy ghatti hai, doosre lafzon mein entropy barhti hai. Agar kisi system ka temperature ghate bhi, us ki entropy ghatate hue, to yeh kisi aur system ki entropy mein khalis izafe ke kharch par hai; jab sab systems ko mil kar kainat mana jaye to kainat ki entropy hamesha barhti hai. (Brain Teaser: taash ki gaddi phentne par zyada be-tarteeb kyun ho jati hai?)

blocks.title: Example 6.5
blocks.text: 0 degrees C par 1.0 kg barf 0 degrees C par pani mein pighalne par entropy ki tabdeeli nikalein. Barf ki latent heat of fusion L_f = 3.36 x 10^5 J kg^-1. Hal: m = 1 kg, T = 0 degrees C = 273 K, L_f = 3.36 x 10^5 J kg^-1. Chunke delta S = delta Q / T, jahan delta Q = m L_f, delta S = m L_f / T = 1.00 kg x 3.36 x 10^5 J kg^-1 / 273 K = 1.23 x 10^3 J K^-1. Yun barf ke pani mein badalne par entropy barhti hai; is soorat mein entropy ka izafa pani ke un molecules ki be-tarteebi ke izafe ka paimana hai jo solid se liquid halat mein badalte hain.

blocks.explanation: delta S = m L_f / T = 0.018 kg x 3.36 x 10^5 J kg^-1 / 273 K = 22.2 J K^-1, chhape 22.0 J K^-1 ke qareeb. Har qudrati amal kul entropy barhata hai, energy ko zyada se zyada yaksan temperature par thermal energy mein girate hue; jab sab temperature ke farq mit jayein to kahin koi heat kaam mein nahi badal sakti, zyada se zyada entropy ki woh halat jo kainat ki heat death ke taur par tasawwur ki jati hai.

items: Entropy (Clausius 1856): delta S = delta Q/T, state variable; heat andar + , bahar -. T1 se T2 tak heat Q (T1 bara): khalis entropy ki tabdeeli Q/T2 - Q/T1 musbat, to qudrati amal system jama mahol ki entropy barhate hain (doosra qanoon); sirf reversible amal mein mustaqil.

Entropy molecular be-tarteebi napti hai (equilibrium tak heat flow, garam karna, azaad phailao); us ka izafa energy girata hai, kaam ke liye kam dastiyab; kainat ki entropy hamesha barhti hai. Example 6.5: 1 kg barf pighal kar 1.23 x 10^3 J K^-1 pati hai.
